name: os-cordova-plugin-nos-widgets
description: Native home-screen widgets (Android Jetpack Glance / iOS WidgetKit) for OutSystems 11 mobile apps.
author: NOS
_comment_dependencies: MABS does NOT run `npm install` for plugin dependencies. `xcode` (used by hooks/ios-add-widget-extension.js) must be VENDORED into the plugin (committed under node_modules/ or inlined) for the hook to resolve it inside the MABS cloud build. This declaration is for local development only.
